about:
Swagelok Louisiana operates from its headquarters in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, with additional offices in Lake Charles, Lafayette, and New Orleans. Founded in 1959, the company serves as the authorized distributor for Swagelok® fluid system components across Louisiana and southern Mississippi. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company distributes Swagelok tube fittings, valves, regulators, and related fluid system components while also providing a range of value‑added services. These include engineering services such as fluid system evaluation, hose evaluation, sample system evaluation, and steam system evaluation; compressed gas leak detection; assembly and fabrication of custom hose assemblies, grab sampling systems, and mechanical seal support systems; hose fabrication and testing; gas distribution system services; and emergency response. Swagelok Louisiana also runs a training academy offering courses in tube fitting installation, orbital welding, tube bending, and process analyzer sampling systems (PASS), and provides tool and equipment rental. The company notes that its grab sample panels are built locally from 15 standard designs and can be customized.

Swagelok Louisiana serves customers in the chemical and petrochemical, oil and gas, power generation, semiconductor, and alternative fuels industries. Its client base includes industrial plants, refineries, and facilities requiring reliable fluid system components and onsite technical support.

The company emphasizes its local presence and specialized assembly environment as key differentiators, stating that its dedicated service team provides expert solutions for customers’ production and operational challenges. It also highlights hands‑on training programs designed to improve workplace safety, efficiency, and productivity.
